registered_before: reading any development score file (data/processed/us_training_v2/dev/*); dev runs were in progress, unread
amends: data/frozen/us_training_v2_protocol.json (operational detail only; no hypothesis, family or threshold changed)

development_mechanics.mlp_early_stopping: inner split: latest target year of the fold's fit rows is the early-stopping set; the model is then refit on all fit rows for the median best epoch; the scored validation year is never used for stopping (v1 used the validation year)
development_mechanics.fit_rows: earlier target years whose label available_at <= issued_at of the validation row's issue kind; holdout counties never fitted
development_mechanics.baseline_fallback: missing history -> fold fit-row median yield

selection.policy: per scope: score(policy) = min over non-baseline candidates c of mean over issue kinds of validation MAE(policy, c, kind); choose the lower score; exact tie -> B
selection.F1_in_season_selected: argmin of in_season validation MAE over {last, mean3, trend, history_ridge} and the non-baseline candidates of the chosen policy; a baseline may win (status reference_selected)
selection.pre_season_weather_model: for pre_6m / pre_18m: argmin over non-baseline candidates of the chosen policy of observed-weather validation MAE at that kind; used inside the ensemble chain
selection.pre_season_history_only: argmin over {last, mean3, trend, history_ridge} of validation MAE at that kind
selection.experiment_arms: each arm (E1a availability_replay, E1a fixed_lag2, E1b v1 population, E3, E4, E2a, E2b) selects by in_season validation MAE over baselines and non-baseline candidates of its own pipeline (policy A, in_season rows only)
selection.base_for_E3_E4: the main pipeline's policy-A in_season selection (identical rows and candidates without the added/replaced features)

chain.members: all eligible analog years whose full target window is complete before issued_at (weather_ensemble.build_ensemble, seed 42); minimum 10
chain.development_chain_years: 2015-2024, pre_6m and pre_18m, models refit per fold exactly as in development
chain.band_predictive: member P50 + empirical quantiles (10%, 90%) of development chain residuals of the same scope and issue kind, pooled over development years; labelled separately

confirmation_scoring.seen_keys: C1 rows of non-holdout counties with a published 2025 value; holdout reported separately
confirmation_scoring.spatial_gate: non-negative MAE gain on holdout counties over development validation years (pairs >= 30), computed from the development predictions frozen before opening
confirmation_scoring.bootstrap: paired county-cluster bootstrap, 2000 reps, seed 42; Bonferroni 53 two-sided -> upper quantile 1 - 0.05/(2*53)
